About this item

  • QUANTUM DOT SUPERSPEED IPS PANEL – The M27Q2 features a stunning 27-inch Superspeed IPS display with Quantum Dot Technology delivering OLED-class color vibrancy with 99% DCI-P3 color gamut coverage.
  • COMPETITIVE EDGE WITH 200HZ REFRESH RATE AND 1MS RESPONSE TIME – Achieve a super-fast response time and smooth motion clarity with an 200Hz/OC 210Hz refresh rate and 1ms GTG response time. Whether you’re in high speed FPS battles or intense esports competitions, the M27Q2 ensures every frame is delivered with precision, giving you the edge when milliseconds matter.
  • LIFE-LIKE COLORS EXPERIENCE – With 1000:1 contrast ratio, 99% Adobe RGB wide color gamut, and 8-bit color depth, you can experience richer, more lifelike colors for a cinema-grade visual experience.
  • SUPPORT VESA DISPLAY HDR 400 – With VESA DisplayHDR 400, the M27Q2 ensures a more realistic and captivating gaming experience with accurate color and contrast reproduction.
  • SUPPORT AMD FREESYNC PREMIUM & NVIDIA G-SYNC COMPATIBLE – With AMD FreeSync Premium and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility, the M27Q2 provides an enhanced gaming experience by reducing screen tearing and stuttering.
